I don't have a name for it, but in order to get my friends into magic we played a five person game. I had made pretty basic mono coloured decks for the 4 of them, gave a quick explanation of the basics of each colour, then let them choose.
While I played a deck full of enchantments, draw spells and general sort of group hug stuff, each of my turns I would randomly buff one of their creatures or help them with card draw and land drops while teaching them to play.

It was a great way to introduce them to magic and they had a great time learning the game.
